description: This file defines the AlertsController class for handling alert-related actions such as retrieving, adding, marking as read, and redirecting alerts within the SuiteCRM system, which is an extension of SugarCRM.

classes.name: AlertsController
classes.description: Controller class managing alert actions such as fetching, adding, marking as read, and redirection within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_get
methods.description: Fetches and prepares alert notifications for the current user.

methods.name: action_add
methods.description: Adds a new alert or reminder for the current user, supporting optional parameters and duplicate checks.

methods.name: action_markAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific alert as read based on the record ID passed via GET.

methods.name: action_redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the alert's URL and marks it as read.
